standards.original_requirement: Maximum building height is 10 meters.
Farm silos may reach 15 meters with a conditional use permit.
exceptions: A conditional use permit is required.

standards.original_requirement: Front setback shall be at least 8 meters from a local road; on a corner lot, the setback from the secondary street may be reduced to 5 meters.
exceptions: On a corner lot, the setback from the secondary street may be reduced to 5 meters.

standards.original_requirement: Side setbacks shall be at least 3 meters, except that a 6-meter side setback is required along a boundary shared with an agricultural conservation district.
exceptions: A 6-meter side setback is required along a boundary shared with an agricultural conservation district.

standards.original_requirement: Rear setback shall be at least 7.5 meters.
Maximum floor area ratio is 0.35.
Maximum building coverage is 30 percent.
Minimum lot area is 0.4 acre for lots served by public sewer.
Minimum lot area is 1 acre for lots using onsite septic.
Minimum lot width is 18 meters.

source_text: Planning Code of the Borough of Bracken Vale — Rural Residential District RR-1: Maximum building height is 10 meters. Farm silos may reach 15 meters with a conditional use permit. Front setback shall be at least 8 meters from a local road; on a corner lot, the setback from the secondary street may be reduced to 5 meters. Side setbacks shall be at least 3 meters, except that a 6-meter side setback is required along a boundary shared with an agricultural conservation district. Rear setback shall be at least 7.5 meters. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.35. Maximum building coverage is 30 percent. Minimum lot area is 0.4 acre for lots served by public sewer and 1 acre for lots using onsite septic. Minimum lot width is 18 meters.

applicability: Buildings within 30 meters of a residential district boundary.

The side setback is at least 6 meters where a lot abuts a public street.
